scripts.db:migrate: pnpm exec prisma migrate dev --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:deploy: pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:setup: pnpm pg:start && pnpm db:migrate -- --name init && pnpm db:seed
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @erp/api build && pnpm --filter @erp/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
